title: Peggy's Cove Sunset tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our Peggy’s Cove Sunset Tour isn’t just a sightseeing trip—it’s an unforgettable coastal experience that showcases one of Nova Scotia’s most iconic destinations at its most beautiful time of day.

Unlike daytime tours, this experience allows you to witness Peggy’s Cove bathed in the warm glow of sunset. Golden hues reflecting off the ocean and granite rocks create a breathtaking atmosphere.

A Tour Designed for Lasting Memories– Whether you're traveling solo, as a couple, or with family and friends, this tour offers a peaceful and memorable way to experience Nova Scotia's stunning coastline.

Perfect for Photographers & Nature Lovers– The soft evening light creates incredible photo opportunities, with the famous lighthouse, crashing waves, and rugged granite shoreline providing the perfect backdrop.

Weather-Dependent– To provide the best sunset experience, this tour is weather dependent. Sunset visibility and colours can vary based on cloud cover and weather conditions.
